cover_letter.name: Goonja Gandhi
paragraphs: With nearly 5 years as a Senior Frontend Engineer focused on React and TypeScript, I'm excited about the Front-End Engineer role at Guardsquare. Your work in mobile app security resonates with my experience building secure, performant systems like NewsAlign, where I integrated auth, rate limiting, and optimized APIs. I'm fully open to relocating within the EU to join your team.

At Tata Consultancy Services, I redesigned state management for data-heavy interfaces using RxJS and TypeScript, cutting unnecessary API calls by 40% and easing frontend-backend collaboration—skills directly applicable to your REST/gRPC integrations. In NewsAlign, I optimized the React frontend through code splitting and bundle analysis, shrinking bundle size from 941KB to under 300KB while boosting Lighthouse scores from 73 to 95. At Datapret, I enhanced accessibility in a React/Redux app, lifting WCAG compliance by 30%.

• Reduced API calls 40%, streamlining data flow.
• Improved perf metrics 30%+ via optimizations.
• Delivered WCAG gains for better usability.

These results show my ability to maintain user-friendly frontends, write reliable tests (Jest, ~84% coverage), and contribute to CI/CD—ready to support Guardsquare's performance goals and innovative solutions. I'd welcome discussing how my background fits your needs.
cover_letter.closing: Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute.
